title: Classified signals lab picks up a signal from the implant
place_text: Southwest Research Institute, San Antonio, Texas

tellings.quote: And it turns off. And the lab guys say, "We've got a signal, but we can't tell you anything about it because the lab's classified."

plain: A secret signals lab picked up a signal coming from a tiny object taken from his body, says the writer Whitley Strieber, who believes the object is an implant and who says he has met aliens. He tells Michels that between 1993 and 1996, at the Southwest Research Institute, a research organisation in San Antonio, Texas, the signal came and then switched off, and the staff told him, "We've got a signal, but we can't tell you anything about it because the lab's classified." He also names a man called William Malow in the account, and if it happened, the object was sending out something that a secret lab could detect.
